context: Request: the underwriting breakdown of every Capital Markets matter (including shelved, withdrawn and never-executed ones) across firm-commitment, best-efforts and other structures. Rubric: 20 matters as firm commitment, including IPO and follow-on underwriting agreements and Rule 144A initial-purchaser note offerings (1005-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1021-00002, 1039-00002, 1044-00004, 1045-00001), the block trade 1017-00001 and 1020-00003; the ATM program 1036-00002 as best efforts; the direct Reg D placement 1013-00002 as other; plus precision (placement-agent, fund PPM, bond and ABS matters such as 1004-00002, 1024-00004, 1030-00001, 1045-00006 are outside).

divergence: All three runs fail in the same way. Each reached every needed matter through broad path searches and text-extraction scans, then screened only part of them: the first error in all three is at the screening stage, where surfaced matters were left unopened (two firm-commitment matters and the direct placement in T0; several note offerings and the direct placement in T1; four firm-commitment matters and the direct placement in T2). The answers then misbucket matters (T0 read the initial-purchaser note offerings and put them under Other; T1 classified unread ones as undetermined; all three put the ATM program under Other) and include placement-agent, bond and ABS matters. The screening reviews raised only generic warnings about unopened matters; the write reviews of T0 and T1 named the 'other' bucket as possibly misclassified, and the check stages only fixed paths and wording.
